answer_2.quote: We employed five classic metrics in the field of speech generation, including Mel-Cepstral Distortion (MCD) , Structural Similarity Index Measure (SSIM) , Word Error Rate (WER) , Short-Time Objective Intelligibility (STOI) , and Speaker Embedding Cosine Similarity (SECS) . ... In addition to these matching-based metrics, we utilized some style-related acoustic metrics, including gender, age, pitch, energy, speed, emotion, and their average score (i.e., mean).

answer_4.quote: We adopted three popular metrics , including QMOS for measuring the acoustic quality; IMOS for gauging the consistency with instructions; and RMOS for evaluating the realness or human-likeness of the voice. ... Each sample is rated by 7 participants, recruited from undergraduate students majoring in Computer Science or English, with a total payment of $1000. The raters' agreements were measured by the kappa κ statistic . The kappa κ scores were 0.81, 0.75, and 0.82 for QMOS, IMOS, and RMOS, respectively, which indicated a good agreement.
answer_4.guideline: Participants read the synthesis instruction and listen to both the ground truth and the generated speech, then score each sample on a 5-point scale ('5' for excellent, '4' for good, '3' for fair, '2' for poor, '1' for bad).
